title: design list
description: The designs in the root, from get design. A reader lists every design with what it is for, how big it is and how it is kept.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always DesignList, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: One row per design in the root.

items.description: One design: its design.yml, and what e-designer counts and reads about it.

design.description: The design's design.yml as written. The counts sit beside it, never in it, so they are never written into design.yml.

purpose.description: What the design counts as, a word of the purpose list: the one design.yml states, or the default (reference) when it states none, so a reader can treat every design by its purpose.

purpose_set.description: True when design.yml states the purpose; false when it is only the default. A reader can show it as not set, as get design does with reference (not set).

components.description: How many resources the design holds that somebody writes, such as Blocks, Risks and Questions; a design's own definitions can add kinds. It says how big the design is in what people work on.

resources.description: How many resources the design holds in all, derived ones included. Beside components, it explains a design folder larger than its components suggest.

storage.description: How the design is kept: distributed, a folder with one file per resource, or single, one file holding every file but layout.yml (see design storage). Every reader and writer goes through e-designer, so only a person needs to know which.

design.description: A design's design.yml: the design itself, as written.

apiVersion.description: Always core/design/v2, the form a design's files are written in at this contract (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml). A reader that meets another form knows the file is not one this contract reads (ADR-S16).

kind.description: Always Design: the design itself, not a resource in it.

id.description: The design's id, always its folder's name, so a design cannot claim a name nobody can select on the command line.

title.description: The design's name for people; left out when design.yml states none.

spec.description: What design.yml says, such as its purpose and description, as written. Written by the design's user, so it stays open (CT-RULE-4).
